name: IG30CODM Colored Dissolved Organic Matter Sensor
shortDescription: Ultraviolet fluorescence measures colored dissolved organic matter directly in water. A compact probe, automatic cleaning brush and digital communication support continuous online monitoring in rivers, lakes, groundwater and wastewater, with deployment tailored to the monitoring location.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Sensor, using the principle of ultraviolet fluorescence analysis, specifically designed to detect colored soluble organic matter in water bodies
◆ It is applicable to the measurement of colored soluble organic matter in Rivers and Lakes, with high sensitivity, small size, automatic cleaning brush, etc., suitable for long-term online monitoring
◆ Applied in environmental monitoring, groundwater monitoring, marine research, wastewater treatment and other fields
◆ RS485 output, supporting MODBUS, can be easily integrated into water quality monitoring systems to meet customer needs
Application areas:
Environmental monitoring, groundwater monitoring, marine research, wastewater treatment
Technical parameters:
Measurement range: 0-400ppb
Measurement principle: UV fluorescence method
Measurement accuracy: ± 3% of the reading
Repeatability: less than ± 3%
Detection limit: 0.1 ppb
Response time: 4 seconds
Linearity: R2>0.999 (continuous dilution of standard solution)
Water sample requirement: flow rate: 0-3m/s; Pressure: 0-100psi; 0-6bar; Temperature: 0-50 ℃
Communication interface: ModbusRS485
Threaded interface: standard 3/4NPT
Protection level: IP68
Installation methods: immersion type, circulation type
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Sensor material: 316L
Electrode size: 190mm * 46mm
